sections.title: 9.1 What is Streaming?
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **Streaming means the LLM sends its response word-by-word (token-by-token) as it generates them, instead of waiting until the complete response is ready.**

### Analogy: Typing vs. Delivering a Letter
```
WITHOUT STREAMING (Batch Response):
User sends question → [Waiting... 30 seconds...] → Full answer arrives at once

WITH STREAMING (Token-by-Token):
User sends question → "The" → "answer" → "to" → "your" → "question" → ...
                    (Each word appears immediately as it's generated)
```

### Why Streaming Exists
LLMs generate text sequentially — one token at a time. Without streaming:
1. User asks question
2. LLM generates response (takes 10-60 seconds for long responses)
3. User stares at loading spinner... 😩
4. Full response appears at once

With streaming:
1. User asks question
2. First word appears in < 1 second
3. User starts reading while LLM keeps writing
4. Much better experience! 😊

### How Streaming Works Technically

```
SERVER                              CLIENT
  │                                   │
  │  User: "Explain AI"               │
  │◄──────────────────────────────────│
  │                                   │
  │  data: {"token": "Artificial"}    │
  │──────────────────────────────────►│  "Artificial"
  │  data: {"token": " Intelligence"} │
  │──────────────────────────────────►│  "Artificial Intelligence"
  │  data: {"token": " is"}           │
  │──────────────────────────────────►│  "Artificial Intelligence is"
  │  data: {"token": " the"}          │
  │──────────────────────────────────►│  ... keeps going
  │  data: [DONE]                     │
  │──────────────────────────────────►│  Complete!
```

This uses **Server-Sent Events (SSE)** or **WebSockets** protocol.

### Code Example (Python with OpenAI)

```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()

# WITHOUT STREAMING (waits for full response)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain AI in 3 sentences"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)  # Prints all at once

# WITH STREAMING (word by word)
stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain AI in 3 sentences"}],
    stream=True  # ← This one parameter enables streaming!
)

for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.choices[0].delta.content is not None:
        print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content, end="", flush=True)
        # Each chunk is 1-2 tokens, printed immediately!
```

### When to Use Streaming

| Use Case | Stream? | Reason |
|----------|---------|--------|
| Chatbot/Chat UI | ✅ YES | Better UX, feels responsive |
| Long document generation | ✅ YES | Users see progress |
| Short classifications | ❌ NO | Response is instant anyway |
| Background processing | ❌ NO | No user waiting, simplicity |
| Structured JSON output | ❌ NO | Easier to parse complete JSON |
